title_fil: Kumilos nang higit, kumain nang wasto
title_en: Priority area 1: Move More, Eat Right
objectives_fil: Magtanong sa nakagawiang gawain ni Ben, magbigay ng nasuring mensahe, at pumili kasama niya ng kayang gawin.
Makinig sa concern, gamitin ang kasalukuyang aprubadong gabay, at iugnay si Ana sa midwife o lactation support kung kailangan.
Gamitin ang kasalukuyang age guide at mga pagkaing mayroon sa bahay; ipasabi kay Jona ang susunod na hakbang.
Tingnan ang kasalukuyang programa at card, ipaliwanag ang dapat kumpirmahin sa health center, at tugunan ang pangamba nang may respeto.
Gamitin ang nasuring plate at oral-health guide para sa angkop na edad; magpa-teach-back at ituro ang serbisyong kailangan.
Ipaabot ang aktuwal na resulta, ipaliwanag ang pangangailangang sundin ang aprubadong follow-up protocol, at iugnay sa provider.
Pakinggan ang sintomas, gamitin ang nasuring NCD guidance, at i-refer sa angkop na pagsusuri at follow-up.
Tukuyin ang uri ng concern, gumamit ng kasalukuyang screening guidance, at iugnay sa provider na makapagpapayo.
objectives_en: Given a household's routine, select one feasible reviewed food or activity message without shaming.
Given a breastfeeding concern, provide approved counseling and identify when qualified help is needed.
Given a child's age and household food options, explain the reviewed age-appropriate feeding approach.
Given a child program card, identify the due service and address a caregiver concern using current local program guidance.
Given an age-group meal and oral-care scenario, demonstrate a reviewed education message and service link.
Given a fictional BP concern, explain follow-up and refer according to a reviewed protocol.
Given a fictional diabetes risk or symptom concern, provide a reviewed prevention/referral message.
Given a resident's question, explain a reviewed risk-reduction or screening route for colon, lung, cervical, breast, or prostate cancer.
summary_fil: Kumilos nang higit, kumain nang wasto: 8 aralin na may kaso, pagsasanay at observer sheet.
summary_en: Priority area 1: Move More, Eat Right: 8 lessons with cases, practice and observer sheets.
